title: Application of poly-DL-methionine/gold nanoparticle-modified recycled battery graphite as an eco-friendly electrochemical sensor for the spasmolytic drug vincamine
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,5336-5352
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07233F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Naglaa Abdel Sattar Kabil, Nada Mousad Refay, Yasmine Ahmed Sharaf, Hisham Ezzat Abdellatef, Rasha M. El Nashar
The present work suggests an ultrasensitive sensor based on the electropolymerization of DL-methionine on a gold-modified battery graphite electrode, poly(DL-met)/AuNPs-BGE, for the analysis of vincamine (VIN) drug.
